description_en: Performs an instance switchover to change the network type of an ApsaraDB RDS instance from the classic network to a VPC
description_zh: 该接口用于将经典网络的RDS实例切换为VPC网络
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-network-type --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --instance-network-type VPC --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceNetworkType

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the classic network endpoint. Valid values:
True: Retains the classic network endpoint.
False (default): Does not retain the classic network endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
是否保留经典网络地址，取值：
True：保留
False（默认）：不保留
parameters.name: retain_classic

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for classic network address reservation. Valid values: 1 to 120. Unit: days. Default value: 7.
This parameter is required when the RetainClassic parameter is set to True
parameters.help_zh:
经典网络地址保留的天数，取值1-120，单位：天。默认值：7。
若传入参数RetainClassic=True，则该参数必传
parameters.name: classic_expired_days

parameters.help_en: The target network type. Set the value to VPC
parameters.help_zh: 目标网络类型，取值固定为VPC：专有网络
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for classic network address reservation for read/write splitting. Valid values: 1 to 120. Unit: days. Default value: 7.
This parameter takes effect only when the instance has a read/write splitting endpoint of the classic network type and the RetainClassic parameter is set to True
parameters.help_zh:
读写分离的经典网络地址保留的天数，取值1-120，单位：天。默认值：7。
当实例存在经典网络类型的读写分离地址，且RetainClassic=True，本参数有效
parameters.name: read_write_splitting_classic_expired_days

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch. This parameter is required when the VPCId parameter is specified
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID，若传入VPCId，则该参数必传
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The Settings for the internal network IP address of the instance. The IP address must be within the address range of the specified vSwitch. By default, the system automatically allocates an IP address based on the VPCId and VSwitchId parameters
parameters.help_zh: 设置实例的内网IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过VPCId和VSwitchId自动分配
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The Settings for the internal network IP address of the read/write splitting endpoint for the instance. The IP address must be within the address range of the specified vSwitch. By default, the system automatically allocates an IP address based on the VPCId and VSwitchId parameters.

This parameter takes effect only when the instance has a read/write splitting endpoint of the classic network type
parameters.help_zh:
设置实例的内网读写分离地址的IP，需要在指定交换机的IP地址范围内。系统默认通过VPCId和VSwitchId自动分配。

当前实例存在经典网络类型的读写分离地址时，该值有效
parameters.name: read_write_splitting_private_ip_address

ConnectionString.description_en: The connection endpoint of the instance
